# youtube-multi-language-audio

> Open-source Python CLI (MIT) that turns translated subtitle files (SRT/VTT) plus the original video into dubbed, time-synced audio tracks for YouTube's multi-language audio feature: one upload-ready track per language, exactly as long as the video, in a cloned voice (the creator's own, or one per speaker), with re-timed captions and a YouTube Studio upload checklist. Voices are generated by the Miragea voice-cloning engine (https://miragea.ai).

## Install and run
- `uvx --from git+https://github.com/RTY2345RR/youtube-multi-language-audio ytmla dub VIDEO video.es.srt video.de.srt --voice my-voice.wav`
- Needs `MIRAGEA_API_KEY` (create at https://miragea.ai/workspace/api). Agent setup: Install https://miragea.ai/skills/miragea-audio/install.md
- ffmpeg is bundled through imageio-ffmpeg.

## Commands
- `ytmla dub VIDEO SUBS... [--voice [NAME=]CLIP|URL] [--voice-text [NAME=]TEXT] [--clone-from-video [NAME=]START-END] [--actor [NAME=]ID] [-o DIR] [--format m4a|wav|mp3|flac] [--max-speedup 1.3] [--two-pass overflow|always|off] [--background STEM] [--multitrack] [--json]`
- `ytmla check VIDEO SUBS...`: offline estimate of lines too long for their time slot (no API key).
- `ytmla doctor`: checks ffmpeg, key and voice engine.
- Language comes from the file name (`video.pt-BR.srt`) or `pt-BR=file.srt`. A folder of subtitle files also works.
- `[Name]`, `Name:` or `(Name):` labels in cues select per-speaker voices.

## Output (per language folder)
- `<video>.<lang>.m4a` (AAC 48 kHz, padded to the video length) to upload in YouTube Studio > Languages > Dub.
- `<video>.<lang>.srt` re-timed captions, `<video>.<lang>.preview.mp4`, `timing.json`.
- Root: `UPLOAD-CHECKLIST.md`, `manifest.json`, optional `<video>.multi-language.mkv`.

## Facts
- The YouTube Data API cannot upload audio tracks; upload is manual in YouTube Studio (Advanced features required; delete an existing auto dub in that language first).
- Sync: each line starts at its cue, is re-voiced faster if too long (two-pass), stretched up to --max-speedup with pitch preserved, never overlaps the next line; leftovers are reported.
- Re-running the same command resumes saved jobs (idempotency keys): no duplicate jobs, unchanged lines are reused.
- Alternative to YouTube auto dubbing and to ThioJoe/Auto-Synced-Translated-Dubs (AGPL, stock TTS voices, translates for you).
